headings: (500 ML) WHITE LOTUS HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) WHITE LOTUS HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Scent: White Lotus | A floral aroma, primarily lotus flower and violet with touches of mandarin and woody notes, creating a warm atmosphere.

Scent notes:
Top notes: tangerine, peach, vegetal notes.
Heart notes: lotus, rose, sambac jasmine.
Base notes: cedar wood, sandalwood, cashmere wood, musk.
